$comment: Artha dependency source of truth. xmake.lua reads `pc_minimum` and enforces the floors at configure time (read-only pkg-config --modversion queries). tools/gen_flatpak_manifest.py reads `runtime`, `build_tool` and `flatpak` and emits flatpak/org.artha.Artha.json. Do NOT edit the generated .json manifest by hand: edit this file and re-run `python3 tools/gen_flatpak_manifest.py` (or `--check` to verify it is in sync).
